title: Propagation from one lift to all lifts
statement: Let $K,K_s,\Omega$ be fields in $\mathrm{Type}\,u$, with compatible embeddings $K\to K_s\to\Omega$, where $K_s$ is a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure] and $\Omega$ is algebraically closed. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$, and $w=\max(u+1,v)$. Let $F$ be a sheaf with values in $\mathrm{Type}\,w$ on the small etale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and let $p$ be the geometric point defined by $K\to\Omega$, with stalk $p^*F$ and germ maps $\gamma_{Y,y}:F(Y)\to p^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Suppose $\rho:G\to(p^*F\to p^*F)$ satisfies $\rho(g)(\gamma_{Y,y}(z))=\gamma_{Y,y^{\prime}}(z)$ whenever $\tau:\Omega\simeq_K\Omega$ extends $g$ and $y^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ y$. No action laws for $\rho$ need be assumed separately. For any nonempty etale $K$-scheme $X$ whose underlying space has exactly one point and function $f:p(X)\to p^*F$ satisfying $f(x^{\prime})=\rho(g)(f(x))$ whenever $\tau$ extends $g$ and $x^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ x$, there exists $z\in F(X)$ such that $\gamma_{X,x}(z)=f(x)$ for every lift $x\in p(X)$. No assertion for empty schemes or for schemes with more than one point is made.

proof.text: The private Lean proof onePoint_lifts_transitive identifies X with the spectrum of its residue field via fromSpecResidueField: X is reduced by etaleness, the residue-field point is a surjective closed immersion on a one-point space, hence an isomorphism. The canonical base ring homomorphism is etale, so Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable proves its residue field is separable over K. The two lifts give K-algebra embeddings into Omega by Spec.homEquiv.

The private Lean proof factor_separable_embedding uses separableClosure K Omega. Its canonical map from Ks is bijective by Normal.toIsAlgebraic.algHom_bijective₂, since both fields are separable closures. CodRestrict each residue-field embedding to that relative separable closure, then compose with the inverse isomorphism, obtaining embeddings into Ks. This works for transcendental Omega and does not assert that Omega is algebraic over K.

The private Lean proof separable_embeddings_conjugate forms the isomorphism between the two embedding images and extends it to g in Gal(Ks/K) using AlgEquiv.liftNormal and liftNormal_commutes. Apply exists_algEquiv_extending_separableClosure to obtain tau on Omega with the required restriction. Its equality on the residue-field embeddings gives x.left = Spec(tau) followed by x₀.left after transporting through the residue-field isomorphism.

Apply the assumed germ-action formula with g, tau, x₀, x and z. Rewrite the given germ equality at x₀ under rho g, then use covariance of f with the same g and tau. These three equalities prove the germ equality at x.

lean.statement:
theorem onePoint_propagate_from_selected_lift
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) [Subsingleton X.left] [Nonempty X.left] :
    let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    ∀ (x₀ : p.fiber.obj X) (ρ : Gal(Ks/K) → p.sheafFiber.obj F → p.sheafFiber.obj F),
      (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
        (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
          τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
        (Y : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (y y' : p.fiber.obj Y)
        (hy : y'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ y.left)
        (z : F.obj.obj (op Y)),
        ρ g (p.toPresheafFiber Y y F.obj z) = p.toPresheafFiber Y y' F.obj z) →
      ∀ (f : p.fiber.obj X → p.sheafFiber.obj F),
        (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (x x' : p.fiber.obj X)
          (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left),
          f x' = ρ g (f x)) →
        ∀ (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
          p.toPresheafFiber X x₀ F.obj z = f x₀ →
          ∀ x : p.fiber.obj X,
            p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z = f x
